title: Senior Backend Developer (PHP / Laravel)
description: About Jack Westin Jack Westin is a leading Medical College Admissions Test (MCAT) preparation company which is known for crafting high quality, but free, practice materials. The MCAT tests students on the scientific reasoning skills and scientific knowledge which can be learned during typical undergraduate coursework. Our Three Principles As we continue to grow and help students, we are guided by three major principles that we believe are vital to our community. Attention to quality We only create courses and practice questions that we would use. That means having the best, first-class teaching content that can possibly exist. We're not satisfied with mediocrity. We don't care about the amount of time or money it takes to get something done right. If it's not perfect, we won't stop until we believe it is. This ethos runs deep within our company. Excellence in support We're obsessed with our students. Their well-being and success drives us each day. Great customer service is not an afterthought. It is the most important service we can offer. We understand that our students come from different learning backgrounds. It's our mission to ensure that each one has an amazing experience. Learn from anywhere at anytime We are committed to building the future of education on the internet so that it is easily accessible to all students from around the world. Our dedication is to all students who want to learn, regardless of their pace, and no matter what time of the day it is. About the Role (Remote | $2,000–$2,500/month) We are hiring a Senior PHP Laravel Software Engineer to lead backend architecture, mentor engineering teams, and build high-performance, scalable systems for JackWestin’s online learning platform. This role requires strong technical leadership and deep Laravel expertise. You will work closely with the team lead, Product, frontend, and QA to turn features into reliable, well-designed services, and you will be expected to contribute to technical planning and architecture decisions, not simply execute predefined tickets. Responsibilities Lead backend architecture and technical decisions. Design scalable and secure distributed systems. Develop and maintain the PHP services and APIs that power our online learning platform. Build and optimize high-performance APIs and services. Work with the team lead to clarify the technical approach, break features into manageable tasks, and flag dependencies or blockers early. Lead technical planning and estimation. Design and update database schemas, write migrations, and optimize queries as the platform grows. Build and maintain integrations with third-party services, including payment and video providers. Write automated tests for new features and bug fixes, review teammates’ merge requests, and document API changes that affect other teams. Review and enforce engineering best practices. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers. Collaborate with frontend developers, Product, QA, and business stakeholders to agree on API contracts, clarify expected behavior, and verify features before release. Handle critical production incidents: investigate issues using logs and monitoring, fix root causes, and add regression tests where appropriate. Improve the security, performance, scalability, and maintainability of existing services through regular fixes and refactoring. Improve CI/CD and deployment workflows. Drive engineering process improvements. What We’re Looking For 6+ years of PHP development experience. Deep Laravel framework expertise. Advanced database architecture knowledge. Strong system design and scalability experience. Experience with queues, Redis, caching, and event-driven systems. CI/CD and DevOps understanding. Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, GCP, DigitalOcean, etc.). Strong debugging and performance optimization skills. Leadership and mentoring experience. Nice to have Microservices architecture. Kubernetes and container orchestration. Event sourcing/CQRS knowledge. High-traffic application experience. Security auditing experience. What We Offer 100% remote, full-time position $2,000–$2,500/month (depending on experience) Real ownership and impact

title: Full Stack Developer – Oyun Tasarımı (React Native, Next.js, PostgreSQL)
description: 97 hakkında 97; izlemeyi, yapay zekâyla sohbeti, okumayı, dinlemeyi ve oyunu tek uygulamada buluşturan bir süper uygulamadır. İçeriği özenle seçmeyi, mahremiyete saygı duymayı ve kullanıcının dikkatini korumayı temel alır. Web, iOS ve Android’de yayındadır. Pozisyon 97'deki oyun deneyimini tasarlayıp uçtan uca geliştirecek, oyun tasarımında deneyimli bir Full Stack Developer arıyoruz. Sorumluluklar Uygulama içindeki oyunları ve oyun deneyimini tasarlamak ve geliştirmek. Oyun mekaniklerini, seviye ilerleyişini, ödül ve görev sistemlerini kurgulamak. BUGLARI düzenli kontrol edip fixlemek sürekli kontrol eden ai ile sistemler geliştirmek Oyun & Uygulama fikirleri ile gelebilmek tercih sebebi. Ailece ve birlikte oynanabilen, çok oyunculu deneyimler geliştirmek. Mobil (React Native) ve web (Next.js) tarafında akıcı, yerli hissi veren arayüzler yazmak. PostgreSQL ile oyun verisini, skor tablolarını ve oyuncu ilerleyişini yönetmek. Oyunların performansını, oyuncu bağlılığını ve elde tutma oranını ölçerek iyileştirmek. Aranan nitelikler Oyun tasarımında kanıtlanmış deneyim: yayınlanmış oyun ya da oyun projeleri React Native ile mobil uygulama geliştirme deneyimi Next.js ve React’e hâkimiyet PostgreSQL ile veri modelleme ve sorgu yazma deneyimi TypeScript’e hâkimiyet Animasyon, dokunma hareketleri ve performans konularına dikkat Fikirden yayına kadar bir işi tek başına götürebilme Tercih sebebi Gerçek zamanlı çok oyunculu sistemler (WebSocket vb.) üzerine deneyim Oyun motorları ya da 2D/3D web teknolojileri (Canvas, WebGL, Phaser, Three.js vb.) Çocuklara ve ailelere yönelik oyun tasarımı deneyimi Oyunlaştırma ve eğitim oyunları üzerine çalışmış olmak Çalışma modeli Freelance Hibrit: haftada 2–3 gün İstanbul ofisinde Süre: 1 ay, ihtiyaca göre 2 aya uzayabilir

title: Full Stack Software Engineer - AI-First
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer – AI-First based remotely in Turkey. In this role, you will help build and scale innovative software solutions that simplify complex global workforce compliance processes. You will join a fully remote, autonomous engineering team where product ownership, technical excellence, and AI-powered development are central to the way work gets done. Rather than relying on traditional manual coding, you will leverage advanced AI coding agents to accelerate development, guide implementation, and deliver high-quality software. Working across frontend and backend development, you will contribute to architectural decisions, product strategy, and end-to-end delivery. You will also take responsibility for application security, system reliability, and cloud deployment. This is an opportunity to work in a forward-thinking engineering environment where autonomy, experimentation, and intelligent use of AI drive continuous innovation. Accountabilities Full Stack Product Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable software applications across frontend and backend systems, contributing approximately equally to both areas. AI-First Engineering: Use and orchestrate AI-powered development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents to accelerate coding, automate repetitive tasks, generate solutions, and improve development efficiency. Technical Architecture and Code Quality: Define technical approaches, guide AI-generated implementations, and review code to ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, reliable, and aligned with engineering standards. Product Ownership and Collaboration: Work closely with Product Managers and other engineers to identify opportunities, shape product direction, prioritize initiatives, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions. Security and Compliance: Take ownership of application security by implementing secure development practices, identifying potential vulnerabilities, assessing risks, and ensuring sensitive compliance data is properly protected. End-to-End Delivery: Participate in the complete software development lifecycle, from initial system design and implementation to infrastructure management, deployment, and ongoing optimization. Cloud Infrastructure and Reliability: Contribute to building and maintaining cloud-based systems, ensuring application performance, scalability, and operational stability. Continuous Improvement: Explore emerging AI development practices, improve agent-assisted workflows, and share technical knowledge to strengthen the team's engineering capabilities. Requirements At least 3 years of professional experience developing and delivering production-ready software applications. Strong software engineering fundamentals, with the ability to work across different programming languages, frameworks, and technology stacks. Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or autonomous development agents in everyday engineering workflows. Ability to evaluate, review, debug, and improve AI-generated code, identifying potential issues related to architecture, security, performance, and maintainability. Experience with full stack development, including frontend and backend application development. Solid understanding of software architecture, APIs, application design, and scalable system development. Good knowledge of application security principles, secure coding practices, and modern cybersecurity threats. Experience contributing to end-to-end software delivery, including system design, deployment, and cloud infrastructure. Ability to work autonomously, take ownership of technical decisions, and contribute effectively in a results-oriented environment with minimal meetings and supervision. Strong problem-solving skills, sound technical judgment, and a continuous learning mindset. Fluent English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within an international remote team. Nice To Have Experience with Java and Spring Boot for backend development. Familiarity with Angular and TypeScript for frontend development. Experience with cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and automated deployment workflows. Previous experience building SaaS platforms or enterprise applications. Familiarity with AI agent orchestration, prompt engineering, and advanced AI-assisted software development methodologies. Benefits Fully Remote Work: Work from anywhere in the world, with a flexible remote-first working environment. 183 Days of Workations: Enjoy up to 183 days per year working from different locations around the world. AI Development Tools: Access to leading AI coding tools and dedicated budgets to support modern, AI-powered engineering workflows. Equity Participation: Opportunity to benefit from Virtual Stock Options (VSOPs) as the business grows. Wellbeing Budget: Receive a monthly budget of €200 for coworking spaces, sports, and wellness activities. Career Growth: Join a rapidly expanding technology environment with opportunities to develop your technical expertise and take on greater responsibilities. Autonomous Team Culture: Work in a collaborative, results-driven engineering team with significant ownership over product development and technical decisions. Innovative Technology Environment: Contribute to the development of modern software solutions using AI-first engineering practices and emerging technologies. International Collaboration: Work alongside experienced professionals in a globally distributed organization focused on innovation and continuous improvement. How Jobgether Works We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
